```{r}
#| label: setup

# set code chunk option defaults
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  # display code as types
  tidy = FALSE, 
  # slightly smaller code font
  size = "small",
  # do not display messages in PDF
  message = FALSE,
  # set default figure width and height
  fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3) 

# improve digit and NA display 
options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = '')

# load packages
if (!require('pacman')) install.packages('pacman'); library('pacman')
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggplot2, lubridate, dplyr, kableExtra, sf, 
               rnaturalearth, janitor, countrycode, stringr)
```

## Data wrangling

```{r}
#| label: shiny-econ-starter-code

#Read in the data
 air <- read.csv("raw-data/air-pollution(air-pollution).csv", skip = 3)
 climate <- read.csv("raw-data/climate-change.csv", skip = 3)
 co2 <- read.csv("raw-data/co2-emissions(co2-emissions).csv", skip = 3)

 #assign the names of the first row to row names
co2 <- co2|>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)
air <- air|>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)
climate <- climate|>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)

climate <- climate |>
  select(-"Indicator Code")

variables<- c("Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)", 
              "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)",
              "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)",
              "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
              "Population growth (annual %)", 
              "Forest area (% of land area)")

climate <- climate |>
  filter(`Indicator Name` %in% variables)
```
